description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Own the cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines for a small product team as its sole infrastructure engineer. The work covers release automation, cloud security, infrastructure as code, monitoring and cost efficiency, all as a hands-on individual contributor who builds and runs the systems directly.
 What you'll do
 - Design, refactor and maintain build and deployment pipelines for several applications and internal workflows across two cloud environments.
 - Set up cloud architecture and security controls, including access policies, network isolation, encryption, secrets handling, logging and automated vulnerability management.
 - Partner with the technical lead and a small engineering group to provide reliable, observable and easily reversible releases.
 - Codify environments as infrastructure definitions, and put in place observability, paging, data protection and outage playbooks across development, staging and production.
 - Set up networking and access for internal compute resources so engineers can use them independently.
 - Improve performance, availability and cloud cost efficiency, and support customer security reviews with documented controls and evidence.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 2 to 5 years of hands-on cloud infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering or site reliability experience.
 - Experience designing and running production CI/CD and deployment pipelines.
 - A hands-on history of creating a cloud environment in a young company or compact group, not just inheriting one.
 - Experience operating production systems on AWS, including compute, networking, identity, storage and databases.
 - Infrastructure as code experience in production with a common tool.
 - Comfort working independently and owning work end to end on a fast-moving team.
 Bonus points
 - Experience with government cloud or other regulated cloud environments with strict compliance requirements.
 - Broader security expertise, for example writing security policies, offensive testing or vulnerability research.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 155,000 to 180,000
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, CA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days a week
 - Full-time
